templates.pattern: A=1, B=2, C=3... Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: Simple A1Z26 cipher. Convert numbers to corresponding letters

templates.pattern: Caesar cipher shift +[N]. Decode: [WORD]
templates.explanation: Caesar cipher: shift each letter back [N] positions

templates.pattern: Reverse alphabet: A=Z, B=Y, C=X... Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: Atbash cipher: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X. Decode by reversing

templates.pattern: Symbol code: ☆=A, ★=B, ○=C, ●=D. Decode: [SYMBOLS]
templates.explanation: Each symbol represents a letter. Decode using given key

templates.pattern: Binary code: A=01, B=10, C=11. Decode: [BINARY]
templates.explanation: Each 2-bit pair represents a letter. Decode pairs

templates.pattern: ROT13 cipher. Decode: [WORD]
templates.explanation: ROT13: shift each letter 13 positions (A→N, B→O, etc.)

templates.pattern: Morse code: .-=A, -...=B, -.-.=C. Decode: [MORSE]
templates.explanation: Standard Morse code. Decode each pattern

templates.pattern: Number pattern: 1=[A], 2=[B], 3=[C]. Code: [X][Y]. Sum?
templates.explanation: Each number maps to value. Sum values of [X] and [Y]

templates.pattern: Vowel code: A=1, E=2, I=3, O=4, U=5. Word [WORD] encodes to?
templates.explanation: Find vowels in word and replace with numbers: CAT→C1T

templates.pattern: Position cipher: 1st letter +1, 2nd letter +2, 3rd +3. Encode [WORD]
templates.explanation: A+1=B, B+2=D, C+3=F → BDF. Encode similarly

templates.pattern: Color code: Red=R, Blue=B, Green=G. Pattern: [C1][C2][C3]. Decode?
templates.explanation: Take first letter of each color: Red,Blue,Green → RBG

templates.pattern: Keyboard shift: Each letter → right neighbor. A→S, B→N. Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: Reverse keyboard shift to decode

templates.pattern: Skip cipher: Take every [N]th letter from [TEXT]. What word?
templates.explanation: Every [N]th letter forms the code word

templates.pattern: Number sum: Letters→numbers (A=1,B=2...). Word [WORD] sums to?
templates.explanation: CAT = 3+1+20 = 24. Calculate sum for word

templates.pattern: Mirror digits: 1↔9, 2↔8, 3↔7, 4↔6, 5↔5. Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: 1→9, 9→1. Mirror each digit: 19→91

templates.pattern: Phone keypad: 2=ABC, 3=DEF, 4=GHI... Code: [NUMBERS]. First letter option?
templates.explanation: 222 on keypad 2(ABC) = C (3rd press). 333 = F

templates.pattern: Pig Latin: [WORD] in Pig Latin is?
templates.explanation: CAT → atcay (move C to end, add 'ay'). If starts with vowel, just add 'ay'

templates.pattern: Reverse code: [WORD] backwards is?
templates.explanation: Simply reverse the letters: CAT → TAC

templates.pattern: Alternate case: [WORD] in alternating case starting with [CASE]?
templates.explanation: HELLO with upper start: HeLlO. Lower start: hElLo

templates.pattern: Grid code: Letters in 3×3 grid. Position (2,2) is [LETTER]. What letter?
templates.explanation: Standard grid: A-I in 3×3. (2,2) is typically E

templates.pattern: XOR cipher: [A] XOR [B] = ?. A=[X], B=[Y]
templates.explanation: Binary XOR operation: 5(101) XOR 3(011) = 6(110)

templates.pattern: Alphabet position sum: [WORD] positions sum to?
Polybius square: Row [R], Column [C] = [LETTER]. What letter?
templates.explanation: 5×5 grid with alphabet (I/J combined). Position determines letter

templates.pattern: NATO phonetic: [CODE] stands for?
templates.explanation: Alpha=A, Bravo=B, Charlie=C, Delta=D, Echo=E

templates.pattern: Substitution: A=[X], B=[Y], C=[Z]. Code [WORD]
templates.explanation: Direct substitution using given mapping
